test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 12 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct voice.**

The old man, with a nostalgic smile, said that he had visited that small town many times in his youth.

options.text: The old man said, "I visited that small town many times in my youth."
The old man said, "He had visited that small town many times in his youth."
The old man said, "I have visited this small town many times in my youth."
The old man said, "I had visited this small town many times in my youth."

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. "The old man said, 'I have visited that small town many times in my youth.'"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **indirect speech**, where the original statement has been reported rather than quoted directly.
 
• To convert it into **direct speech**, we must accurately reconstruct the speaker's original words, using appropriate pronouns and verb tenses.
 
• In direct speech, the verb "said" is followed by the quoted statement enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• The pronoun "he" in indirect speech changes to "I" in direct speech, as the old man is referring to himself.
 
• The verb "had visited" in indirect speech changes to "have visited" in direct speech because the reporting verb "said" is in the past tense.

Correct sentence: *The old man said, "I have visited that small town many times in my youth."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Direct speech:** The exact words of the speaker are quoted, enclosed in quotation marks, and the tense is kept as it was originally spoken.
 
• **Indirect speech:** The speaker's words are paraphrased or reported, often involving changes in pronouns, verb tenses, and time expressions.
